artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze with Cupid and Psyche
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental scroll design with cherubs. The drawing features intricate scrolling patterns with cherubic figures integrated into the swirling foliage and ornamentation. The cherubs have rounded forms and are playful. The central portion includes a reclining cherub framed by ornate scrollwork, creating a sense of symmetry and balance. Fine, detailed lines give the piece a rich and complex appearance, typical of such designs.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze with Marine Creatures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornate decorative scrollwork with mythical creatures. The image features intricate and elaborate scroll designs that include fancifully designed horses integrated into swirling patterns. In the center, two winged creatures appear emerging from the ornamental curves. Above them, a row of repeated sinuous and flowing forms resembling sea creatures adds to the mythical ambiance.

artworks.title: Two Ornamental Bands with Chained Leopards and Eagles
artworks.description: The image displays two distinct ornamental friezes. The upper section features two large felines, decorative scrollwork, helmets, foliage, and intricate line work. The lower section showcases an eagle with outstretched wings amidst scroll forms, detailed line work, and ornamentation. The design is reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque artistic styles, emphasizing nature and mythology in an ornate composition.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze with Grape Vine
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythical creatures and dense foliage. The scene shows a central group of creatures that appear part human, some covered in fur or scales. Vines and foliage surround them. The figures are in dynamic motion, interacting with each other. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading, highlighting textures of fur, foliage, and mythical features.

artworks.title: Three Ornamental Bands
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring ornate scenes involving animals and figures. The upper section of the image shows intricate scrollwork with leafy and floral motifs. In the center, a hound is chasing a hare between two winged figures merging with foliage. Below, a smaller panel depicts a scene with a dog or hound lunging at another animal, possibly a roe or boar, set amid stylized vegetation. The panels are rendered with meticulous detail, typical of Baroque ornamental prints integrating dynamic forms and elaborate floral designs.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze with Children and Dogs
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of an intricate decorative design featuring foliage, floral motifs, and cherubic figures. The composition includes swirling patterns and flowing lines, creating a dynamic and lively composition. The detailed etching showcases a high level of skill in engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Dolphins and Tritons
artworks.description: The image shows two figures with human torsos and fish-like tails entwined with large sea creatures resembling serpents or whales, amidst swirling waters. The texture is detailed, with precise lines and shading. The figures are engaged with the animals, symbolizing themes of mythology and marine life.

artworks.title: Two Ornamental Bands with Cupid and Heads of the Four Seasons
artworks.description: The image contains sweeping lines and elegant shapes creating movement. Abstract decorations resembling foliage or floral patterns are present, with human faces intertwined in the design like relief sculptures. Tendrils resembling hair or vines frame the faces. In the top center, a small cherubic figure is nestled among the forms. The overall composition evokes Baroque ornamental design, conveying elegance and grandeur.

artworks.title: Ornamental Frieze with Eagle and Lion Engarlanded by Children
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative motif with mythological and animal elements. The work features a central long frieze adorned with intricate scrolling designs and flourishes, interwoven with fantastical creatures and natural elements. This includes a central eagle surrounded by garlands or foliage, two cherubim figures or mythological beings, and prominent lion features on either side. Below the frieze, there is a depiction of a classical figure with a raised arm, possibly mythological, interacting with an animal figure, and a separate sketch of a bearded head. The overall composition suggests a decorative purpose, possibly intended for architectural ornamentation or a similar artistic application. The style is characterized by detailed etching that emphasizes the dynamic flow and fluidity of the lines.

artworks.title: Two Leopards Jumping a Festoon Supported by Children
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological creatures and animals intertwined with a decorative garland. The etching depicts a group of putti interacting with animated animals that are entwined in a garland. The putti are adorned with garland and grapevine motifs. The animals bear comically exaggerated features. The use of lines and shading gives a sense of texture to the fur and the foliage. This etching combines elements of nature and mythology in a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate cartouche featuring two winged cherubs, an intricate and decorative design. The cherubs are seated amidst scrolls and foliage motifs, with a lion's head at the center holding rings in its mouth. Ribbons and flourishes extend from the lion's head, adding to the baroque-inspired elegance of the piece.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative cartouche with figures and intricate detailing. The image features a symmetrical design predominantly made of flowing, organic lines that resemble classical acanthus leaf patterns. At each side of the cartouche, there are semi-nude cherubic figures with curly hair, one on the left and another on the right, each leaning into the frame of the cartouche with their legs wrapped around the scrollwork. The figures interact with the flourish of acanthus leaves and elaborate curvilinear motifs around them. The whole composition is executed with fine, detailed line work, giving it a sense of elegance and classical beauty typical of baroque or rococo styles. The central area of the cartouche is vacant.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged mythological figures forming an ornate frame. The image depicts two symmetrical figures facing away from each other, each resembling a mythological creature with human-like torsos and long wings. Their lower bodies morph into swirling shapes and decorative ornate scrolls that meet at the center, forming a decorative crest. The detailed linework gives texture and depth, with the composition created to resemble an elaborate decorative border or frame.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative design. The image features an intricate and symmetrical composition with scrollwork and decorative floral elements surrounding a central area. The central portion includes swirling clouds and ornate flow, framed by detailed acanthus leaves on either side. In the upper center of the composition, there is an angelic figure with flowing hair amidst the clouds. The border features drapery elements. The use of line is precise and controlled, creating a sense of depth and texture within the decoration.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate cartouche design. The image features a symmetrical and intricate decorative border. The design incorporates elements reminiscent of Baroque or Rococo styles, with swirling acanthus leaves and other flourishes. The lines vary in thickness, giving the drawing depth and texture, and the composition is neatly contained within a rectangular form. The use of shadow within the line work suggests a three-dimensional quality to the ornamentation.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical rococo-style frame or cartouche. The design consists of swirling, elaborate scrollwork and decorative flourishes typical of the Rococo movement. The scrolls have a delicate, almost feather-like quality, with spirals and curves interwoven and mirrored on both sides. The central space within the frame is left empty. The overall composition is highly decorative and rich in detail, with fine lines and careful attention to the curvatures and shapes that convey a sense of movement and elegance.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: The image displays swirling shapes and curving lines forming an intricate design. The central patterns resemble ornate scrollwork, while the upper section includes a face-like figure. The rounded and flowing forms on either side could be reminiscent of foliage or clouds. The arrangement resembles an elaborate frame or decorative border.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental cartouche with a ram's head at the top center. The cartouche is elaborately designed with scrolling and leafy elements extending outward from the central ram's head. On either side, there are clusters of foliage or floral designs. The border of the cartouche features curved lines and intricate details. The ram's head has exaggerated curled horns. At the bottom, there are more curling motifs completing the ornate appearance.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: The image shows swirling, curvilinear lines and shapes forming an elaborate frame-like design. Two large feline figures are positioned symmetrically on either side of a central empty space. The creatures are embedded within ornate scrolling forms resembling waves, feathers, or clouds. The embellishments evoke decorative motifs found in classical architectural elements or heraldic designs.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: The image displays an ornate abstract design with flowing lines and curves forming a symmetrical arrangement. In the center is an empty shield or coat of arms shape, surrounded by cloud-like forms and tendrils that curl outward. At the top are festoons or garlands resembling leaves or feathers. The design evokes movement and decoration, reminiscent of baroque-style embellishments.

artworks.title: Cartouche
artworks.artist: François Collignon after Stefano Della Bella
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, blank cartouche. The drawing features a highly decorative frame with elaborate, curling scrolls and flourishes around a central blank shield area. The design is symmetrical, with swirls resembling foliage or clouds, and baroque-style embellishments. The lower part of the image contains a thin strip with some text indicating attribution. The drawing has delicate and detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Archangel Michael Weighing a Soul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure weighing souls. The image features a winged figure standing over a collection of grotesque, demonic forms with a set of scales. The figure is dressed in flowing robes and holds a sword aloft in one hand. The scales are suspended in front of the figure, with a small human form seated in one balance and a demonic figure in the other. The background includes rolling hills and a castle-like structure. The drawing is intricately detailed, with crosshatching and fine lines defining the textures. The use of black and white shades creates strong contrasts that emphasize the dramatic tension. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of early Renaissance woodcuts.

artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design for a confessional booth. The image shows a detailed architectural rendering of a baroque-style confessional, complete with ornamental carvings, scrollwork, classical motifs, columns, arches, and a cross-section. The detailed engravings and flourishes suggest a style consistent with Baroque architecture.

artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure. The drawing presents the front view of a intricately designed structure. The top of the structure is crowned with a triangular pediment that contains a central motif of a winged cherub. A cross is mounted above the pediment. Below, the structure features Corinthian columns flanking a central panel that showcases elaborate scrollwork and drapery. The panel has a symmetrical floral design. The drawing includes detailed ornamentation such as spiraling volutes near the columns, indicating a baroque style emphasizing grandeur and rich detailing.
